message.text:
The concrete implementation is the unexported `markdown.service`, the sole implementation of `markdown.Service`.

`markdown.NewService` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` constructs the service via `NewAPIV1Service`. `Server.NewServer` creates the APIV1Service. `APIV1Service` and `RSSService` hold the interface. `memopayload.Runner` declares a field but never uses it. At runtime `APIV1Service` and `RSSService` execute the implementation.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` accepts `markdown.Service` and receives it from `memo_service` via `s.MarkdownService`.

markdown.service — NewAPIV1Service via markdown.NewService (server/router/api/v1/v1.go); holders APIV1Service and RSSService

`markdown.Service` has one impl, the unexported `service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. Production constructs it in `NewAPIV1Service` with `WithTagExtension` and `WithMentionExtension`. `Server.NewServer` passes that same instance into `rss.NewRSSService`. `memopayload.Runner` also holds `markdown.Service`, but `NewRunner` is unused at runtime; memo create/update call `RebuildMemoPayload` with `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`.
